humanSurface.rule: The dashboard renders the same structured artifacts used by the machine route; it is not a second truth store.

boundaries: Structured artifacts show claims, evidence, seams, decisions and tests; hidden chain-of-thought is not collected or displayed.
Identity, wisdom, profile, skills, prompts and specialist masks stay typed and do not silently become permissions.
Optional profile statistics are context metadata and are excluded from learning text.
A verified lesson may enter private practice under the standing policy but cannot change the stable runtime.
Typed contract boundary exams remain distinct from real lessons and parent-linked counterexamples; generated wording is not authority and held-out module IDs never enter training.

Typed handoff routes are proposal-only manifest-bound exact emits-to-accepts compositions; declaration is not a permission grant, readiness stays unknown, and matches or generated unbound decoys never train or execute a module.

A separate typed Technical Glasses overlay may classify compatible routes READY, AVAILABLE, NEEDS_ACTION, or BLOCKED; stale and UNKNOWN evidence hold, while READY and AVAILABLE remain review-only and never start or repair a module.

Specifically missing readiness probes may originate reviewable typed hand requests automatically; other UNKNOWN states remain inspection holds, and no request writes code, installs a probe, starts or repairs a service, grants permission, or enters training.

Exact consumer demand plus zero exact providers may originate one reviewable nonbuilt provider-declaration gap hand; the hand never infers provider identity, schema, path, implementation, availability, permission, or readiness and never builds or writes a declaration.

Each verified nonbuilt provider-declaration hand may originate an independent research-exam request with untested architectures and typed held-out cases; the future candidate cannot author expected outcomes or held-out fixtures, and no exam request selects, builds, executes, trains, or resolves its own gap.

A bounded read-only survey may assess each JSON document under Workshop shared independently against the current research-exam relations. It preserves partial, malformed, symbolic, and missing evidence without merging files into a fictional provider; pattern frequency and even a complete structural witness cannot select or evaluate architecture, build a provider, claim readiness, or enter training.

A following static survey may read bounded JavaScript source text under Workshop shared and record exact demanded-selector literals plus conservative export, registration, require, assertion, and selftest-path signals. It never executes source; a selector witness is not an outer provider binding, provider identity, implementation selection, architecture evaluation, permission, readiness claim, or training example.

A balanced experiment planner may pair every eligible exported selector source with every positive UNTESTED architecture hypothesis and the independently authored case families. Tests and non-exported sources remain validation-only; no frame, provider identity, declaration schema or path, permission set, source, implementation, or architecture is selected, executed, built, written, granted, or admitted to training.

The automatic Shell route submits no reviewed provider-declaration research-executor recipes and records an empty builder batch. A separately attributed HUMAN review may later admit only the fixed ignored-state relation executor and its ten pre-authored synthetic fixture families; even a passing suite selects or evaluates no real architecture, builds no provider or declaration, establishes no readiness, and never enters training.

The automatic Shell route submits no reviewed probe recipes and records an empty candidate batch; it cannot impersonate a human reviewer, infer a target, generate an automatic candidate, install, run live, or treat fixture presence as READY.
Synthetic counterexamples retain parent and intervention lineage, never enter held-out evaluation, and never become semantic truth.
Metamorphic matches remain immutable evaluation traces; only mismatches may enter negative episodic evidence and the Frontier exam route.
Applicable atomic metamorphic operators may compose pairwise automatically, but recursive composition beyond depth two is refused.
External Hermes may be connected later through an adapter; this module never pretends that runtime is installed.
